# Check — M0-e-02, consolidation round R2 of `@plat/site`, closing check (lane `check/M0-e-02-consolidate-close-1`, flow-7, 2026-10-12)

The closing check of round C1 of M0-e-02 (lane `build/M0-e-02-consolidate-1`; plan `consolidation/site-plan.md` §1.2
H-1 – H-14, §2 C-hydro-1 – 3, §3.2 T-hydro; rulings J260, J263 Q1, Q6, Q8, J264 (5), J268 Q3, J270 (a), (b), J290,
J301 Q1, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8). The checker is not the round's author. It planned its probes and its 44 targeted mutants
before it read the author's notes section, and it ran them in its own mirrors under
`scratchpad/waves/check-M0-e-02/` (`before/`, `after/`, two cross mirrors, two mutant mirrors). The first check's file
`checks/M0-e-02.md` is unchanged, as J269 requires. No git command was run. No file of the item was changed.

**The before-image.** Without git, the pre-round sources were taken as copies of the 12 `src/hydro` and 7 `test/hydro`
files and checked byte for byte against the SHA-256 that the session's `landed/snapshots/flow-7.json` records for them.
All 19 of 19 are equal, so each copy is the committed pre-round file whatever its source. The copies came from the
lane's scratch folder. They were also checked against the plan's line citations, for example `strategy.ts:28–29` `PI`,
`RAD_PER_CDEG`, `d8.ts:143` `Counts`, and `surface.ts:1` "fix round 1". The `before/` mirror is the tree as it stands
now, with the two hydro folders replaced by those 19 files. The checker's other evidence was produced in its own
mirrors.

## Verdict: PASS

* Every failing line of the brief is fixed and holds against its oracle (CONFIRMED, re-run with the checker's own
  evidence; table (1)).
* Every gate exits 0 (CONFIRMED; table (2)). The gates are `install --frozen-lockfile`, `lint` (probe-red ok),
  `build`, NEAR at the PR size and `landed:verify flow-7 --item M0-e-02`. RELATED@1000 gives 2739/2740. Its one red is foreign: `testkit/test/edge/repins.test.ts` at seed 2521534151 (M0-x-06's in-flight repin) is red identically on the pre-round hydro sources.
* The checker's NO-SHIFT probe (3 487 lines) is identical before and after the round except for 4 lines. Those 4 lines
  are the two dropped, unpinned throw texts. They are reached only by a hand-built 0-column or NaN-column grid passed
  to the public helpers `edgePoint` and `inletMasks`. The same `RangeError` is thrown at the same call; only its text
  changes (J301 Q1).
* Refusals over the registered families: **0 → 0** (519 `runRivers` runs). Degraded deliveries: 441 → 441, which is
  C-0175 (8)'s declared tier and not a refusal.
* No export of the barrel or of the hydro index changed, in name or type (CONFIRMED by the TypeScript checker's export
  listing).
* The checker ran 44 targeted mutants: 37 are red on `test/hydro`. One survivor is equivalent (N05). The other six
  survivors are not equivalent: K15′, K20, K24, K24c, L3e and N02. Each of the six also survives the pre-round tests on
  the pre-round sources (56/56), so no kill was lost in this round. They are inherited pin gaps. Under the plan's
  routing (J268/J273: KI pin gaps go to the hardening queue; T-hydro "no new pin") they are notes, not blockers.
* No new finding is a blocker. Four notes, N-c1-5 – N-c1-8, are appended to `checks/M0-e-02-notes.md`.
